title: Skin mesotherapy
what: The doctor gives many tiny injections into the skin and puts in small amounts of medicine or moisturizing mixtures.
why: To moisturize and improve the look of the skin, and for some kinds of hair loss - as decided by the doctor.
duration: the procedure usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; usually a course of several sessions
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners

prepare.title: Bruises
prepare.text: Alcohol is usually not advised before the procedure - ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Important event
prepare.text: Do not plan the procedure right before a celebration - bruises are possible.

steps: Your skin is cleaned and treated with antiseptic
A numbing cream is usually applied
The doctor gives many tiny injections
The skin is treated with antiseptic again
feel: The injections feel like light pricks
Afterwards there is redness, small bumps and sometimes bruises
after: The bumps usually go away in 1 to 2 days
For a day, no makeup, bath house or workouts
red_flags: Severe pain, swelling or heat at the injection sites - see a doctor
Swelling of the face or trouble breathing - call your local emergency number

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?
faq.a: Usually a course of several procedures. The doctor will tell you the exact number.

faq.q: When will I see the result?
faq.a: Usually after several procedures. The effect does not last forever.
